status: Research registry, not executed dataset adapters or verified binary inventory

policy.license_scope: Code, recordings, annotations, meshes and learned models require separate review.
policy.inspection: Primary paper, author release, dataset card and/or selected listing; not a fresh sample-level validation.

datasets.name: RealImpact
datasets.use: Multi-position object identification and acoustic transfer evaluation.
limits: Prior project subset has corrected mono responses, not raw paired force.
Not gentle wet-ear contact.
datasets.license: Recording and mesh terms require release-specific review; code license is separate.

datasets.name: ObjectFolder-Real
datasets.use: Mesh-aligned contact identification and geometry-aware fitting.
limits: Physical overlap with RealImpact; reconcile object identities before dataset splits.
datasets.license: Dataset and upstream mesh terms not established by this inspection.

datasets.name: Cluster Haptic Texture Dataset
datasets.use: Conditioned friction with bounded load/speed interpolation.
limits: Raw channels are main and machine-noise reference, not ears.
Force converter is 80 Hz despite faster value logging.
Processed audio must remain distinct from raw audio.
datasets.license: Repository code declares Apache-2.0; separately inspect Figshare recording terms.

datasets.name: Tactile, Audio, and Visual Dataset During Bare Finger Interaction with Textured Surfaces
limits: Audio Nyquist frequency 6250 Hz, not upper-band validation.
Smooth-sliding selection bias.
Microphones are not a dummy-head binaural pair.
datasets.license: Check Figshare record 26965267; article terms are not automatically every asset's terms.

datasets.name: Hearing Hands
datasets.use: Optional action-conditioned source/detail model, distinct from physical calibration.
limits: No calibrated force-to-pressure map.
Published model downsamples to 16 kHz; not evidence for 8-20 kHz sound detail.
Vocoder and scene transfer need listening validation.
datasets.license: Official code links data and checkpoints; review all terms before adoption.

datasets.name: ObjectFolder 2.0
datasets.use: Modal pretraining and numerical solver comparison.
limits: Synthetic sound is not independent real-world ground truth.
datasets.license: Author page states CC BY 4.0 with original mesh terms retained.

datasets.name: NISR on Hugging Face
datasets.use: Candidate pretraining only after independent modal and numerical checks.
limits: Coarse 32-cubed voxels and up to 20 modes.
No predefined split.
Material blends are assumed interpolation, not physical composite measurements.
datasets.license: Card states CC BY 4.0; original ObjectFolder mesh rights remain.

datasets.name: FSD50K
datasets.use: Sound-family coverage and timbre/recognition examples, not physical calibration.
limits: Uncontrolled capture and no synchronized contact-force trajectories.
datasets.license: Mixed per-clip Creative Commons terms including noncommercial restrictions.

datasets.name: SCHAEFFER
limits: Processed/designed sounds are not raw physical trials.
HF visible records inspected; Kaggle binary not inspected.
datasets.license: Authors state CC BY 4.0 for data; keep code/data and per-asset provenance separate.

datasets.name: EPIC-SOUNDS
limits: Not isolated source or capture calibration.
datasets.license: Author repository states CC BY-NC 4.0, not an unrestricted production corpus.

datasets.name: 6KSFx
limits: Reconcile per-category counts and augmentation wording against archive inventory.
datasets.license: Downloadable terms require inspection; metadata display alone was insufficient.

datasets.name: KleinPAT dataset
limits: Far-field assumptions do not establish touching/occluded-ear transmission.
datasets.license: Review research-use and upstream mesh conditions.

datasets.name: Extended SONICOM
datasets.use: Receiver validation, kept separate from source synthesis.
limits: Human HRTF does not identify KU100/3Dio contact transmission.
datasets.license: Review receiver, scan and derivative terms separately.

datasets.name: AcoustiTrace
datasets.use: Causal and acoustic-relation evaluation beyond plausibility.
limits: 2026 preprint; no artifact execution in this pass.
Room absorption labels are not elastic material measurements.
datasets.license: Release and original-source rights require separate review.
